$Comment: Names the hytale:world_pvp reading for requirement lines: 1 when the world the question is asked in lets players hurt each other (the world's own PvP switch, /world config pvp), else 0. Use it to keep something to PvP worlds: an effect's ApplyConditions through ZigRequires, an item's use gate, a held effect's Requires, a reward row. A condition on it needs Min 1; Max 0 keeps something out of PvP worlds. It is asked fresh every time (Volatility Moment), since the game says nothing when the switch changes.
